bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Step 2 of the example study: the run as a complete, runnable fragment, the follow-up phase of the CONSORT flow. Six Behaverse tasks plus the jsPsych Flanker, administered one trial at a time through one message-passing interface (human or artificial actor alike); every trial is logged to the BDM trials dataset under the declared schema. A run whose failed-trial rate exceeds 20% on any task exits through a boundary error event to a single counted error end event.
